archive.exportHelp: A zip holding everything you own (agenda, tasks, missions, documents, architecture), the shared directory and your files, with a readable Markdown copy of each document.
archive.importHelp: Restores an export into this account. The account must hold no data yet (public holidays aside); the same archive cannot be imported twice into one instance.
archive.confirmMessage: The content of {{name}} will be added to your account.
archive.missingFiles_one: {{count}} file was missing from the archive.
archive.missingFiles_other: {{count}} files were missing from the archive.

backups.title: Backups
backups.help: The administrator backs up and restores the whole instance (database and files) from the server; see docs/OPERATIONS.md.

markdown.title: Import Markdown
markdown.help: A zipped folder of .md notes, such as an Obsidian vault. Folders become parent pages, [[wikilinks]] between notes are kept and embedded images become attachments.
markdown.unresolved_one: {{count}} link to a missing note left as written
markdown.unresolved_other: {{count}} links to missing notes left as written

csv.title: Import CSV
csv.help: Columns: first_name, last_name, job_title, email_work, email_personal, phone_work, phone_mobile, linkedin_url, company, notes. Separator ; or ,. Missing companies are created; known contacts are skipped.
csv.preview: {{created}} to create, {{skipped}} already known, {{companies}} new companies.
